artifact_observations.location: Front right wheel and fender area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The front right wheel appears to merge unnaturally with the fender and the ground. The tire sidewall lacks definition and seems to melt into the pavement, lacking a clear contact patch shadow.
The vertical pillars supporting the roof seem slightly warped and inconsistent in thickness. The connection point between the front pillar and the roof edge looks soft and ill-defined.
The black material on the back lacks realistic fabric texture or wrinkles; it appears as a flat, noisy matte block that doesn't react to light realistically compared to the rest of the scene.

Slight inconsistency in depth of field; some background elements are sharp while others nearby are blurred, suggesting minor generation artifacts in depth mapping, though less severe than structural issues.
